provenance: Synthetic calibrated surface indicators for DEMO-01. Spatial patterns derived from borehole grade distribution via IDW. NOT derived from real satellite imagery. Architecture is integration-ready for Sentinel-2 / ISRO Bhuvan / Landsat.

ndvi.description: Normalised Difference Vegetation Index — depressed over mineralised zones

iron_oxide_idx.description: Iron oxide spectral index — elevated over Fe-Mn gossans and altered soils

clay_alter_idx.description: Clay / alteration index — hydroxyl absorption in SWIR bands

soil_moisture.description: Soil moisture proxy — NDWI-derived surface water content

prosp_score.description: Composite surface prospectivity score (0–1); higher = stronger surface anomaly

key_disclaimer: Surface indicators provide spatial context and surface evidence only. They do NOT directly detect subsurface manganese ore. Subsurface reserve estimation is based on borehole composites and Ordinary Kriging (PRISM module). These two evidence streams are complementary, not substitutes.
data_sources_integration_ready: ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A (10–20 m multispectral)
